en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.155 - Muhammad Al-Halabi asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) about a man who becomes junub (ritually impure due to seminal discharge) while wearing a garment and has no other garment to wear.
Imam (as) said: 'He should pray in it, and when he finds water, he should wash it.'.
